name: FizzBuzz
description: Print numbers 1-100, but multiples of 3 are 'Fizz', multiples of 5 are 'Buzz', multiples of both are 'FizzBuzz'.
test: assert len(fizzbuzz()) == 100 and fizzbuzz()[14] == 'FizzBuzz' and fizzbuzz()[2] == 'Fizz' and fizzbuzz()[4] == 'Buzz' and fizzbuzz()[0] == '1'

name: Find Duplicates
description: Return a list of duplicate elements from an input list, preserving first-seen order.
test: assert find_duplicates([1,2,3,2,4,3,5]) == [2,3] and find_duplicates([]) == [] and find_duplicates([1,1,1]) == [1]

name: Flatten Nested List
description: Flatten an arbitrarily nested list into a single flat list.

name: Palindrome Check
description: Check if a string is a palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
test: assert is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') == True and is_palindrome('race a car') == False and is_palindrome('') == True

name: Fibonacci
description: Return the first n Fibonacci numbers as a list.
test: assert fibonacci(8) == [0,1,1,2,3,5,8,13] and fibonacci(1) == [0] and fibonacci(0) == []

name: Matrix Transpose
description: Transpose a matrix (list of lists). Rows become columns.

name: Run-Length Encoding
description: Compress a string using run-length encoding. 'aaabbc' -> [('a',3),('b',2),('c',1)]
test: assert rle_encode('aaabbc') == [('a',3),('b',2),('c',1)] and rle_encode('') == [] and rle_encode('a') == [('a',1)]

name: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest common subsequence of two strings.
test: assert lcs_length('abcde','ace') == 3 and lcs_length('','abc') == 0 and lcs_length('abc','abc') == 3

name: Caesar Cipher
description: Encrypt a string with Caesar cipher (shift letters by n, wrap around, preserve case, skip non-alpha).
test: assert caesar('Hello, World!', 3) == 'Khoor, Zruog!' and caesar('abc', 0) == 'abc' and caesar('xyz', 3) == 'abc'

name: Group Anagrams
description: Group a list of words by anagrams. Return list of groups (sorted internally, groups sorted by first element).
